articles.title: Welcoming the Costa Rican Government to Have I Been Pwned
articles.summary: Today, we welcome the 42nd government onboarded to Have I Been Pwned’s free gov service: Costa Rica.The CSIRT of the Government of Costa Rica now has access to monitor government domains against the data in HIBP. This enables their national cybersecurity incident response team to identify exposure
articles.summary_zh: Troy Hunt在其博客宣布哥斯达黎加政府成为第42个加入Have I Been Pwned（HIBP）免费政府服务的国家。该国国家网络安全事件响应团队（CSIRT）现可监控政府域名是否出现在HIBP的泄露数据库中，以便及时发现并应对数据泄露风险。
articles.why_matters: 了解国际网络安全协作模式及政府级数据泄露监测服务的实践案例。
articles.tags: 网络安全，数据泄露，政府服务，HIBP

articles.title: Sony Betamax VCR: Born May 10, 1975
articles.summary:
The consumer VCR turns 51 this week. On May 10, 1975, Sony introduced the Betamax. Although Betamax lost the famous format war, it kicked the door open, being the first VCR format that mere mortals could aspire to own and
The post Sony Betamax VCR: Born May 10, 1975 appeared first on The Silicon Underground.
articles.summary_zh: 1975年5月10日，索尼推出Betamax格式的录像机，成为首个普通消费者能够拥有的VCR格式。尽管Betamax在后来的VHS与Beta格式之争中败北，但它开创了家庭视频娱乐的新纪元，让录像机从专业领域走入千家万户。
articles.why_matters: 了解消费电子发展史，Betamax的创新与失败都是宝贵的案例。

articles.title: Fear is information.
articles.summary: The motivational industry has built any number of small empires on the notion that fear is a problem to be either managed, suppressed or out-manoeuvred. Fight the fear, etc. The language is typically martial - as if fear were a hostile enemy, camped at the gates of your better self.
articles.summary_zh: 文章挑战了传统励志行业将恐惧视为敌人、需要克服的观点。作者认为恐惧并非需要对抗的消极情绪，而是大脑向我们传递的重要信息，提示我们关注潜在的风险或机会。与其把恐惧当作入侵者来对抗，不如将其视为值得倾听的信息源。
articles.why_matters: 提供一个颠覆性的视角，帮助读者将恐惧从需要战胜的敌人转化为可利用的信息工具。
articles.tags: 恐惧管理, 心态调整, 心理学启示

articles.title: Probability that a random binary matrix is invertible
articles.summary:
The two latest posts have involved invertible matrices with 0 and 1 entries. If you fill an n × n matrix with 0s and 1s randomly, how likely is it to be invertible? What kind of inverse? There are a couple ways to find the probability that a binary matrix is invertible, depending on what […]
The post Probability that a random binary matrix is invertible first appeared on John D. Cook.
articles.summary_zh: 文章探讨了随机填充0和1的n×n二进制矩阵可逆的概率问题，介绍了计算这一概率的几种数学方法。这个概率随着矩阵维度n增大而变化，涉及线性代数和概率论的交叉应用。
articles.why_matters: 对于理解随机矩阵性质和概率论在代数中应用的入门者很有帮助。
articles.tags: 线性代数，概率论，随机矩阵，离散数学

articles.title: Inverse shift
articles.summary:
What is the inverse of shifting a sequence to the right? Shifting it to the left, obviously. But wait a minute. Suppose you have a sequence of eight bits abcdefgh and you shift it to the right. You get 0abcdefg. If you shift this sequence to the left you get abcdefg0 You can’t recover the […]
The post Inverse shift first appeared on John D. Cook.
articles.summary_zh: 文章探讨了序列移位操作的逆操作问题。作者通过8位序列abcdefgh的例子说明，将序列右移后再左移会丢失原始数据，因为移位引入的0会覆盖有效位信息，看似直观的“逆操作”实则无法完全恢复原始序列。这一问题揭示了有限精度计算中信息丢失的本质。
articles.why_matters: 文章以简洁的数学例子阐明了移位操作在有限序列中的不可逆性，启发对信息保存的深层思考。
articles.tags: 位运算，数学趣题，信息论

articles.title: Hosting a website on an 8-bit microcontroller.
articles.summary:
In today's episode of "dumb things to do with an AVR microcontroller":




Does your server come with real wood?


MCU website demo
(may go down if this gets posted to HN)


My victim is the AVR64DD32 which is quite similar to the Atmega328 of Arduino fame.
Compared to the older Atmega, these are cheaper for the same memory, use a single programming pin and have nicer peripherals:


CPU:Single 8-bit AVR core @ 24 MHz (max)
RAM:8 kB (static RAM)
Flash:64 kB
EEPROM:256 bytes
Voltage:1.8 - 5.5 Volt
articles.summary_zh: 作者在AVR64DD32这款8位微控制器上尝试托管一个网站，将其作为“用AVR微控制器做蠢事”系列实验的一部分。该MCU与Arduino常见的Atmega328相似，但资源极为有限，作者展示了在这种受限硬件上运行Web服务器的可行性，并提供了演示链接。
articles.why_matters: 展示了在极度受限的嵌入式平台上运行网络服务的极限挑战，适合对硬件极限探索和嵌入式开发感兴趣的读者。

			The New York Times profiled Medvi and reported they're on track to make $1.8 billion this year. Clearly AI worked for them... if you ignore the alleged fraud for just a second. And while Microsoft now claims that at least 30% of their code is AI-gener
articles.summary_zh: 文章探讨了关于AI的不同观点——有人积极使用AI工具每月产出大量代码，也有人认为AI不够智能，双方都有各自的证据支持。这反映了AI在技术领域引发的分歧，以及不同开发者如何基于自身经验和成果形成截然相反的判断。
articles.why_matters: 帮助理解为何AI争议如此激烈，启发我们思考不同立场背后的真实原因。

articles.title: The New PowerMac
articles.summary:
Apple stopped selling the Power Mac G5 (with space) in August 2006, so I’m not sure how much they care about Kraft using “PowerMac” (sans space) as a trademark for protein-enhanced macaroni and cheese. (I feel like there’s got to be a joke to be made here about a “cheese grater”...)


 ★
articles.summary_zh: 2006年8月，苹果停止销售Power Mac G5，用户对这款经典高性能电脑的讨论也告一段落。然而，几乎同一时期，食品公司卡夫（Kraft）却注册了“PowerMac”商标，用于蛋白质强化的通心粉和奶酪产品。文中还调侃了Power Mac G5的机箱设计被网友戏称为“奶酪刨丝器”（cheese grater），与食品公司卡夫的“奶酪”通心粉意外形成了一个双关的笑点。

articles.title: Using LLM in the shebang line of a script
articles.summary:
TIL: Using LLM in the shebang line of a script
        Kim_Bruning on Hacker News:

But seriously, you can put a shebang on an english text file now (if you're sufficiently brave) [...]

This inspired me to look at patterns for doing exactly that with LLM. Here's the simplest, which takes advantage of LLM fragments:
#!/usr/bin/env -S llm -f
Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

But you can also incorporate tool calls using the -T name_of_tool option:
#!/usr/bin/env -S llm -T llm_time -f
articles.summary_zh: 这篇文章介绍了如何在脚本的shebang行（#!/...）中使用大型语言模型（LLM）来执行脚本。通过将LLM命令放在shebang位置，开发者可以用自然语言编写脚本，由AI来解释和执行代码，实现了一种全新的脚本编写方式。这种技术展示了AI在编程领域的创新应用，让普通文本文件也能具备可执行能力。
articles.why_matters: 展示了编程与AI结合的前沿技巧，适合对新技术和编程创新感兴趣的开发者阅读。
articles.tags: LLM应用, shebang技巧, AI编程

articles.title: Your AI Use Is Breaking My Brain
articles.summary:
Your AI Use Is Breaking My Brain
Excellent, angry piece by Jason Koebler on how AI writing online is becoming impossible to avoid, filtering it is mentally exhausting and it's even starting to distort regular human writing styles.
I particularly liked his use of the term "Zombie Internet" to define a different, more insidious alternative to the "Dead Internet" (which is just bots talking to each other):

I called it the Zombie Internet because the truth is that large parts of the internet are no
articles.summary_zh: 这是一篇愤怒而精彩的文章，作者Jason Koebler探讨了AI生成内容在互联网上变得不可避免的问题。他指出过滤这些内容在精神上令人极度疲惫，更糟糕的是，AI写作甚至开始扭曲普通人的正常写作风格。文中提出的“僵尸互联网”（Zombie Internet）概念尤为精准，深刻揭示了当前互联网写作面临的困境。
articles.why_matters: 文章用“僵尸互联网”这个精准的隐喻，深刻揭示了AI写作对网络生态和人类创作的负面影响，观点犀利有力。
articles.tags: AI写作, 互联网文化, 数字生活
